codes.definition_en: Air Mix Damper Control Servo Motor Circuit (Front Passenger Side Lower Air Mix)
codes.translation_ar: خلل في دائرة محرك سيرفو بوابة مزج الهواء السفلي الأمامي جهة الراكب
symptoms: Uneven passenger-compartment vent temperature or airflow
Little or no air from certain vents
Wrong MODE/blend operation

causes.cause: HVAC ECU calibration/servo control or servo sticking
causes.evidence: L-SB-0001-21 Rev1 directs calibration update and conditioning utility before motor replacement

causes.cause: Particular damper servo remains flagged by cleaning utility
causes.evidence: Replace ONLY flagged part after tool check, vehicle variant and exact parts table

causes.cause: Other electrical / power / connector or damper mechanical faults
causes.evidence: Not diagnosed by this bulletin alone; OEM Repair Manual necessary

diagnostic_steps.action: Verify VIN, exact equipment (HVAC servo layout), production/model year and calibration with Lexus TIS; confirm bulletin and vehicle eligibility.
Capture HVAC symptoms (uneven temperature/airflow, little/no outlet airflow, incorrect MODE) and read the air conditioning ECU DTC with Techstream.

Check AC amplifier calibration ID. If eligible, follow OEM one-time A/C amplifier flash reprogramming; use approved battery support in Power Supply Mode. 13.5 V target; minimum above 11.4 V per this bulletin only.
Complete the prescribed servo cleaning utility with MODE=Face, temperature=Max Cold, Air Inlet=Recirculation. Use the utility only with new HVAC ECU calibration.

Recheck which DTCs remain after the utility. Replace only the specific servo still flagged after matching hardware, Active Test item, group and exact part number to VIN. If B1497/B149A occurs, this bulletin does not apply; diagnose communication per Repair Manual.
Re-read DTC and verify HVAC operation; if conditions remain, continue OEM Repair Manual rather than guessing connector pins or replacing all servos.

codes.definition_en: Engine Coolant Bypass Valve Circuit Short to Ground
codes.translation_ar: قصر إلى الأرضي في دائرة صمام تجاوز سائل تبريد المحرك
symptoms: "Engine Maintenance Required" message in MID
DTC detected during health check (MIL state not stated in bulletin)

causes.cause: Water bypass/flow-shutting valve or hose-valve assembly as applicable
causes.evidence: Lexus L-SB-0051-24 Rev1 conditional targeted repair

causes.cause: Harness, connector, supply or valve circuit fault
causes.evidence: Circuit nature suggests checks; wiring pinout and electrical threshold absent in bulletin; not ranked or certified by this bulletin

diagnostic_steps.action: Confirm the vehicle and Engine Maintenance Required message are present; if not, bulletin does not apply.
Use GTS+ Health Check and confirm P268111 is stored; check for both P268111 and P268115 and freeze-frame if available.
Match vehicle to UX200 MY2019–2021 M20A-FKS, ES300h MY2019–2021 A25A-FXS, or ES250 MY2021 A25A-FKS; market USA. Match VIN and campaign 24LE02 before ordering parts.
Visually examine valve connector and wiring safely for corrosion, separation, or damage; electrical pin/voltage targets unknown and require the matching Lexus Repair Manual.
Only within bulletin eligibility, replace exact model-specific water valve or water bypass valve hose assembly as listed; use applicable Lexus TIS model-year removal/installation.
Use GTS+ clear codes and road-test. If code persists, follow VIN-specific cooling diagnostics; no universal ECU pinout or specified resistance supplied.

Use GTS+ Health Check and confirm P268115 is stored; check for both P268111 and P268115 and freeze-frame if available.
Match vehicle to UX200 MY2019–2021 M20A-FKS, ES300h MY2019–2021 A25A-FXS, or ES250 MY2021 A25A-FKS; market USA. Match VIN and campaign 24LE02 before ordering parts.
Visually examine valve connector and wiring safely for corrosion, separation, or damage; electrical pin/voltage targets unknown and require the matching Lexus Repair Manual.
Only within bulletin eligibility, replace exact model-specific water valve or water bypass valve hose assembly as listed; use applicable Lexus TIS model-year removal/installation.
Use GTS+ clear codes and road-test. If code persists, follow VIN-specific cooling diagnostics; no universal ECU pinout or specified resistance supplied.
